no-api-keys.description: Block API keys, tokens, and secrets from commits
no-api-keys.code:
#!/bin/bash
# Block API keys, tokens, secrets from being committed

BLOCKED_PATTERNS="(api[_-]?key|apikey|token|secret|password|private[_-]?key|aws[_-]?access|aws[_-]?secret|PRIVATE[_-]?KEY|API[_-]?KEY|TOKEN|PASSWORD|SECRET)"

echo "🔍 Checking for secrets..."

files=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM)
FOUND=

for file in $files; do
  [ -f "$file" ] || continue
  
  if grep -Eiqo "$BLOCKED_PATTERNS" "$file" 2>/dev/null | head -1 > /dev/null; then
    echo "❌ Blocked: $file contains potential secret"
    FOUND=1
  fi
done

if [ -n "$FOUND" ]; then
  echo ""
  echo "💡 Move secrets to .env or use environment variables"
  exit 1
fi

echo "✅ No secrets detected"
exit 0

no-env.code:
#!/bin/bash
# Block .env and environment files

echo "🔍 Checking for .env files..."

files=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM)
FOUND=

for file in $files; do
  case "$file" in
    *.env|.env|.env.*|.env.local|.env.development|.env.production)
      echo "❌ Blocked: $file is an environment file"
      FOUND=1
      ;;
  esac
done

if [ -n "$FOUND" ]; then
  echo ""
  echo "💡 Add to .gitignore: echo '.env' >> .gitignore"
  exit 1
fi

echo "✅ No .env files detected"
exit 0

no-secrets.description: Block secret file names (pem, key, etc.)
no-secrets.code:
#!/bin/bash
# Block secret key files

BLOCKED_FILES="(\\.pem$|\.key$|id_rsa$|id_ed25519$|\.secret$|credentials$|\.p12$|\.pfx$)"

echo "🔍 Checking for secret files..."

files=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM)
FOUND=

for file in $files; do
  if echo "$file" | grep -Eq "$BLOCKED_FILES"; then
    echo "❌ Blocked: $file appears to be a secrets file"
    FOUND=1
  fi
done

if [ -n "$FOUND" ]; then
  echo "💡 Private keys should not be committed"
  exit 1
fi

echo "✅ No secret files detected"
exit 0

check-jira.code:
#!/bin/bash
# Require JIRA ticket format

COMMIT_MSG_FILE=$1
[ -z "$COMMIT_MSG_FILE" ] && exit 0

COMMIT_MSG=$(cat "$COMMIT_MSG_FILE")
BRANCH=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null | sed 's/.*\///')

echo "🔍 Checking JIRA format..."

# Check branch name
if [ -n "$BRANCH" ] && echo "$BRANCH" | grep -Eq "^[A-Z]+-[0-9]+"; then
  echo "✅ Branch contains JIRA ticket"
  exit 0
fi

# Check commit message
if echo "$COMMIT_MSG" | grep -Eq "^[A-Z]+-[0-9]+:"; then
  echo "✅ Commit message contains JIRA ticket"
  exit 0
fi

echo "❌ Commit must include JIRA ticket (e.g., PROJ-123: Fix bug)"
echo "   Or use branch: git checkout -b PROJ-123-feature"
exit 1

check-branch.description: Enforce branch naming (feat/, fix/, chore/, etc.)
check-branch.code:
#!/bin/bash
# Enforce branch naming convention

ALLOWED_PREFIXES="^(feat|fix|chore|docs|refactor|test|ci|build)/"
BRANCH=$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)

[ -z "$BRANCH" ] && exit 0

echo "🔍 Checking branch: $BRANCH"

if echo "$BRANCH" | grep -Eq "$ALLOWED_PREFIXES"; then
  echo "✅ Branch name is valid"
  exit 0
fi

echo "❌ Branch must start with: feat/, fix/, chore/, docs/, refactor/, test/"
exit 1

no-package-lock.code:
#!/bin/bash
# Block package-lock.json

echo "🔍 Checking lock files..."

files=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM)
FOUND=

for file in $files; do
  case "$file" in
    package-lock.json)
      echo "❌ Use pnpm or yarn instead of npm"
      FOUND=1
      ;;
  esac
done

[ -n "$FOUND" ] && exit 1
echo "✅ No package-lock.json"
exit 0

no-large-files.code:
#!/bin/bash
# Block files >100KB

MAX_SIZE=100000

echo "🔍 Checking file sizes..."

files=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM)
FOUND=

for file in $files; do
  [ -f "$file" ] || continue
  SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$file" 2>/dev/null || stat -f%z "$file" 2>/dev/null)
  
  if [ "$SIZE" -gt "$MAX_SIZE" ]; then
    echo "❌ Blocked: $file is too large ($SIZE bytes)"
    FOUND=1
  fi
done

[ -n "$FOUND" ] && exit 1
echo "✅ All files under size limit"
exit 0

require-emoji.code:
#!/bin/bash
# Require emoji

EMOJI="(✨|🚧|✅|🐛|📝|🎨|🔥|💄|🔧|📦|🚀|💎)"
COMMIT_MSG_FILE=$1
[ -z "$COMMIT_MSG_FILE" ] && exit 0

COMMIT_MSG=$(cat "$COMMIT_MSG_FILE")

if echo "$COMMIT_MSG" | grep -Eq "$EMOJI"; then
  echo "✅ Commit has emoji"
  exit 0
fi

echo "❌ Include emoji: ✨ 🚧 ✅ 🐛 📝 🎨 🔧"
exit 1

check-merge-commit.code:
#!/bin/bash
# Block merge commits

COMMIT_MSG_FILE=$1
[ -z "$COMMIT_MSG_FILE" ] && exit 0
COMMIT_MSG=$(cat "$COMMIT_MSG_FILE")

if echo "$COMMIT_MSG" | grep -qi "^Merge"; then
  echo "❌ Merge commits should be avoided"
  echo "💡 Use git rebase instead"
  exit 1
fi

exit 0
